board: Adafruit AMG8833 IR Thermal Camera Breakout (#3538, STEMMA QT version)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, circuit board, footprint). The model reproduces the datasheet encodings: 64 pixels at 0x80-0xFF as little-endian 12-bit two's complement at 0.25 C/LSB, and the thermistor at 0x0E as sign+magnitude at 0.0625 C/LSB, limited to the 0-80 C high-gain operating range where that encoding is linear. The scene slider sets all 64 pixels to one temperature.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://learn.adafruit.com/adafruit-amg8833-8x8-thermal-camera-sensor/pinouts (STEMMA QT board photo: VIN, 3Vo, GND, SCL, SDA, INT)
